How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage
  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

Pulling into the parking lot before most of the world is even awake.
Or walking out under the stars at the end of a 12-hour shift.

No matter who you are:
Clinician, caregiver or administrator, you carry a heavy load.
The weight of decisions. Of team members. Of patients and families.
Of why you got into this in the first place.

### 
### ICU MEDICAL

## WE SEE YOU

## And we build for you.

Every tool is designed to meet the real-world demands of every shift, every patient, every moment.
They're made to simplify complexity. To streamline workflows. To help reduce risks before they
happen. To support decisions under pressure.

##### All so you can be present, move with purpose and precision and do what you do best.

[ View Products ][187]

### From IV lines to vital signs, we're with you at the heart of care.
* [
  Products
  Infusion Therapy
  
  From catheters to pumps, you can standardize without clinical compromise, so every drop reaches
  patients safely and every shift runs smoother.
  
  ][188]
* [
  Products
  Pharmacy Preparation
  
  Compounding automation, closed system transfer devices, and IV safety software built to give you
  less pressure and more performance.
  
  ][189]
* [
  Products
  Airway Management
  
  From tracheostomy tubes to breathing support, our tools are designed to make every breath count
  and help everyone breathe a little easier.
  
  ][190]
* [
  Products
  Hemodynamic Monitoring
  
  Monitoring technologies that bring clarity to critical decisions without slowing you down.
  
  ][191]
* [
  Products
  Temperature Management
  
  From fluid warming to temperature probes, we help you protect patients perioperatively, so they
  stay safe and stable in your care.
  
  ][192]
* [
  Products
  Renal Care
  
  Help protect hemodialysis catheters, reduce infection risks, and build the trust that renal care
  depends on.
  
  ][193]
* [
  Products
  Pain Management
  
  From spinal and epidural to regional blocks and diagnostic trays, we give you the right tools to
  ease pain and deliver comfort with confidence.
  
  ][194]

[IV Precision Pump Family]

### Introducing the IV Performance Platform

Lead a new wave of IV therapy performance with an intuitive platform designed to help bring safety,
simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo^{™} and Plum Solo^{™}* precision IV
pumps and LifeShield^{™} IV safety software, this fully IV-EHR interoperable, future-ready platform
empowers you to raise the performance of your IV therapy practice—helping to enhance safety and
efficiency across all IV touchpoints.

*Plum Duo v1.2 and Plum Solo v1.0

[ Explore the New Wave of IV Safety ][195]

## Latest news

Stay up to date with our latest news
* [
  News / Sep 18, 2025
  ICU Medical Announces New FDA 510(k) cleared labeling claims for Clave^{™} Portfolio of Needlefree
  IV Connectors with Powerful New Infection Control Data
  New labeling clearance highlights peer-reviewed evidence showing hospitals that standardize on
  Clave technology achieve significantly greater infection reduction and cost savings compared to
  non-Clave hospitals.
  ][196]
* [
  News / May 15, 2025
  ICU Medical and VisionHealth Launch MyAcapella^{™} Digital OPEP Coach to Improve OPEP Therapy and
  Adherence for Respiratory Patients
  New digital coaching app enhances patient experience and clinician oversight through guided
  therapy, reminders, and adherence tracking.
  ][197]
* [
  News / May 01, 2025
  ICU Medical, Inc. and Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. Complete Joint Venture to Bolster IV
  Solutions Manufacturing and Innovation in North America
  The partnership creates one of the largest global IV solutions manufacturing networks with
  combined production of an estimated 1.4 billion annual units and aims to bring additional supply
  chain resiliency and new innovation to the North American IV solutions market.
  ][198]
* [
  News / Apr 07, 2025
  ICU Medical Introduces Its New Category of Infusion Devices With FDA Clearances of Plum Solo^{™}
  and Plum Duo^{™} Precision IV Pumps
  New devices address infusion delivery variability and expand ICU Medical IV Performance Platform
  ][199]

Pulling into the parking lot before most of the world is even awake.
Or walking out under the stars at the end of a 12-hour shift.

No matter who you are:
Clinician, caregiver or administrator, you carry a heavy load.
The weight of decisions. Of team members. Of patients and families.
Of why you got into this in the first place.

### 
### ICU MEDICAL

## WE SEE YOU

## And we build for you.

Every tool is designed to meet the real-world demands of every shift, every patient, every moment.
They're made to simplify complexity. To streamline workflows. To help reduce risks before they
happen. To support decisions under pressure.

##### All so you can be present, move with purpose and precision and do what you do best.

[ View Products ][187]

### From IV lines to vital signs, we're with you at the heart of care.
* [
  Products
  Infusion Therapy
  
  From catheters to pumps, you can standardize without clinical compromise, so every drop reaches
  patients safely and every shift runs smoother.
  
  ][188]
* [
  Products
  Pharmacy Preparation
  
  Compounding automation, closed system transfer devices, and IV safety software built to give you
  less pressure and more performance.
  
  ][189]
* [
  Products
  Airway Management
  
  From tracheostomy tubes to breathing support, our tools are designed to make every breath count
  and help everyone breathe a little easier.
  
  ][190]
* [
  Products
  Hemodynamic Monitoring
  
  Monitoring technologies that bring clarity to critical decisions without slowing you down.
  
  ][191]
* [
  Products
  Temperature Management
  
  From fluid warming to temperature probes, we help you protect patients perioperatively, so they
  stay safe and stable in your care.
  
  ][192]
* [
  Products
  Renal Care
  
  Help protect hemodialysis catheters, reduce infection risks, and build the trust that renal care
  depends on.
  
  ][193]
* [
  Products
  Pain Management
  
  From spinal and epidural to regional blocks and diagnostic trays, we give you the right tools to
  ease pain and deliver comfort with confidence.
  
  ][194]

[IV Precision Pump Family]

### Introducing the IV Performance Platform

Lead a new wave of IV therapy performance with an intuitive platform designed to help bring safety,
simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo^{™} and Plum Solo^{™}* precision IV
pumps and LifeShield^{™} IV safety software, this fully IV-EHR interoperable, future-ready platform
empowers you to raise the performance of your IV therapy practice—helping to enhance safety and
efficiency across all IV touchpoints.

*Plum Duo v1.2 and Plum Solo v1.0

[ Explore the New Wave of IV Safety ][195]

## Latest news

Stay up to date with our latest news
* [
  News / Sep 18, 2025
  ICU Medical Announces New FDA 510(k) cleared labeling claims for Clave^{™} Portfolio of Needlefree
  IV Connectors with Powerful New Infection Control Data
  New labeling clearance highlights peer-reviewed evidence showing hospitals that standardize on
  Clave technology achieve significantly greater infection reduction and cost savings compared to
  non-Clave hospitals.
  ][196]
* [
  News / May 15, 2025
  ICU Medical and VisionHealth Launch MyAcapella^{™} Digital OPEP Coach to Improve OPEP Therapy and
  Adherence for Respiratory Patients
  New digital coaching app enhances patient experience and clinician oversight through guided
  therapy, reminders, and adherence tracking.
  ][197]
* [
  News / May 01, 2025
  ICU Medical, Inc. and Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. Complete Joint Venture to Bolster IV
  Solutions Manufacturing and Innovation in North America
  The partnership creates one of the largest global IV solutions manufacturing networks with
  combined production of an estimated 1.4 billion annual units and aims to bring additional supply
  chain resiliency and new innovation to the North American IV solutions market.
  ][198]
* [
  News / Apr 07, 2025
  ICU Medical Introduces Its New Category of Infusion Devices With FDA Clearances of Plum Solo^{™}
  and Plum Duo^{™} Precision IV Pumps
  New devices address infusion delivery variability and expand ICU Medical IV Performance Platform
  ][199]

The **Institute for Safe Medication Practices Canada** is a **trusted partner** in strengthening
medication safety through learning, sharing, and acting to improve health care.

### Quick links:
* [Latest bulletins][28]
* [Community Pharmacy Reporting & Learning][29]
* [CPhIR][30]
* [MSSA][31]
* [Hospital Reporting & Learning][32]
* [Upcoming events][33]

### Launch of the SMART Medication Safety Agenda

The SMART Medication Safety Agenda turns learnings from incidents reported to the National Incident
Data Repository (NIDR) into practical, system-based guidance to support community pharmacy teams.
This new resource pairs real anonymized examples with recommendations and a ready-to-use action
plan.

[Learn more][34]

## Partner with ISMP Canada

Our team of experts analyze reports of medication errors from across the country and provide
resources, education, and consulting services to improve medication safety.

The Canadian Medication Safety Network provides a chance to hear from health care providers and
consumers about medication safety needs and opportunities from communities across the country.

[Register for the Network][35]

### Learn

We collect and analyze reports of medication errors and other issues so we can *learn* about the
risks related to medications and collaboratively develop strategies to address them.
* Practitioners, community pharmacies, consumers and caregivers can report your experiences with
  medication errors.

[Submit a report][36]

### Share

We *share* lessons learned, including compelling actionable, evidence-informed recommendations that
organizations, practitioners, consumers, and caregivers can use to reduce the risks related to
medications.

[See the latest bulletins for healthcare professionals ][37]
[See the latest consumer newsletters ][38]
[See Shared Learning from Community Pharmacy Reporting][39]

### Act

We partner to implement, sustain, and evaluate medication safety improvements in practice.

Want to *act* now?

Join the Canadian Medication Safety Network to be part of this medication safety community of
learning!

[Register for the Network ][40]

**Consumers and caregivers**
* Review [5 Questions to Ask About My Medications][41] for your next discussion about medications
  with a practitioner
* Other [medication safety resources][42]

For consumer medication safety information, visit:

[MedError ][43]

**Organizations and Practitioners**
* [Resources][44]
* Strengthening Medication Safety in [Long-Term Care][45]
* Medication Safety [Self Assessments][46]
* [Education][47]
* [Consultations][48]

## Safety Bulletins

[Notification sign-up][49] [All bulletins][50]

### 2026 - Volume 26

ISSUE 7

#### [Hospital Readmissions Associated with Medication Incidents during Transitions of Care][51]

Hospital readmissions cost the Canadian health care system an estimated $2.9 billion in 2023. In
addition to the financial cost, returning to hospital can affect the patient's overall health and
their trust in the health care system. This bulletin highlights the findings from an analysis of
medication incidents associated with an emergent need to return to hospital (including hospital
readmissions and emergency department visits). Recommendations to optimize safe transitions of care
are shared to help minimize return to hospital as a result of a medication incident.

[Bulletin PDF][52]
ISSUE 6

#### [Palliative Care at Home – PART 2: ANALYSIS OF A FATAL INCIDENT][53]

Palliative care provides symptom management and supportive care to patients living with serious or
life-limiting illness. Increasing numbers of patients choose to receive this form of care in the
home. This bulletin, the second of a 2-part series, describes the analysis of a fatal incident
involving HYDROmorphone used for pain management in a palliative home care setting and shares
recommendations for the safe procurement, prescription, administration, and monitoring of opioid
medications provided in palliative care kits.

[Bulletin PDF][54]

### [Community Pharmacy Reporting & Learning][57]

Community Pharmacy Reporting and Learning is a component of the Canadian Medication Incident
Reporting and Prevention System (CMIRPS). Community pharmacies in participating provinces
anonymously submit reports of incidents to the National Incident Data Repository for Community
Pharmacies (NIDR) to share learning and inform safety improvements, reflecting a growing culture of
safety in Canada.

### [Canadian Medication Incident Reporting and Prevention System][58]

The Canadian Medication Incident Reporting and Prevention System (CMIRPS) is a collaborative
pan-Canadian program of Health Canada, ISMP Canada, Canadian Institute for Health Information,
Patients for Patient Safety Canada and Healthcare Excellence Canada. The goal of CMIRPS is to reduce
and prevent harmful medication incidents in Canada.

The **Institute for Safe Medication Practices Canada** is a **trusted partner** in strengthening
medication safety through learning, sharing, and acting to improve health care.

### Quick links:
* [Latest bulletins][28]
* [Community Pharmacy Reporting & Learning][29]
* [CPhIR][30]
* [MSSA][31]
* [Hospital Reporting & Learning][32]
* [Upcoming events][33]

### Launch of the SMART Medication Safety Agenda

The SMART Medication Safety Agenda turns learnings from incidents reported to the National Incident
Data Repository (NIDR) into practical, system-based guidance to support community pharmacy teams.
This new resource pairs real anonymized examples with recommendations and a ready-to-use action
plan.

[Learn more][34]

## Partner with ISMP Canada

Our team of experts analyze reports of medication errors from across the country and provide
resources, education, and consulting services to improve medication safety.

The Canadian Medication Safety Network provides a chance to hear from health care providers and
consumers about medication safety needs and opportunities from communities across the country.

[Register for the Network][35]

### Learn

We collect and analyze reports of medication errors and other issues so we can *learn* about the
risks related to medications and collaboratively develop strategies to address them.
* Practitioners, community pharmacies, consumers and caregivers can report your experiences with
  medication errors.

[Submit a report][36]

### Share

We *share* lessons learned, including compelling actionable, evidence-informed recommendations that
organizations, practitioners, consumers, and caregivers can use to reduce the risks related to
medications.

[See the latest bulletins for healthcare professionals ][37]
[See the latest consumer newsletters ][38]
[See Shared Learning from Community Pharmacy Reporting][39]

### Act

We partner to implement, sustain, and evaluate medication safety improvements in practice.

Want to *act* now?

Join the Canadian Medication Safety Network to be part of this medication safety community of
learning!

[Register for the Network ][40]

**Consumers and caregivers**
* Review [5 Questions to Ask About My Medications][41] for your next discussion about medications
  with a practitioner
* Other [medication safety resources][42]

For consumer medication safety information, visit:

[MedError ][43]

* [Education][47]
* [Consultations][48]

## Safety Bulletins

[Notification sign-up][49] [All bulletins][50]

### 2026 - Volume 26

ISSUE 7

#### [Hospital Readmissions Associated with Medication Incidents during Transitions of Care][51]

Hospital readmissions cost the Canadian health care system an estimated $2.9 billion in 2023. In
addition to the financial cost, returning to hospital can affect the patient's overall health and
their trust in the health care system. This bulletin highlights the findings from an analysis of
medication incidents associated with an emergent need to return to hospital (including hospital
readmissions and emergency department visits). Recommendations to optimize safe transitions of care
are shared to help minimize return to hospital as a result of a medication incident.

[Bulletin PDF][52]
ISSUE 6

#### [Palliative Care at Home – PART 2: ANALYSIS OF A FATAL INCIDENT][53]

Palliative care provides symptom management and supportive care to patients living with serious or
life-limiting illness. Increasing numbers of patients choose to receive this form of care in the
home. This bulletin, the second of a 2-part series, describes the analysis of a fatal incident
involving HYDROmorphone used for pain management in a palliative home care setting and shares
recommendations for the safe procurement, prescription, administration, and monitoring of opioid
medications provided in palliative care kits.

The Ministry of Long-Term Care (MLTC) in Ontario is partnering with ISMP Canada to support long-term
care homes in strengthening medication safety.

### [Community Pharmacy Reporting & Learning][57]

Community Pharmacy Reporting and Learning is a component of the Canadian Medication Incident
Reporting and Prevention System (CMIRPS). Community pharmacies in participating provinces
anonymously submit reports of incidents to the National Incident Data Repository for Community
Pharmacies (NIDR) to share learning and inform safety improvements, reflecting a growing culture of
safety in Canada.

### [Canadian Medication Incident Reporting and Prevention System][58]

The Canadian Medication Incident Reporting and Prevention System (CMIRPS) is a collaborative
pan-Canadian program of Health Canada, ISMP Canada, Canadian Institute for Health Information,
Patients for Patient Safety Canada and Healthcare Excellence Canada. The goal of CMIRPS is to reduce
and prevent harmful medication incidents in Canada.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

Staying true to our founding principles of being a price disruptor, we deliver affordable medication

Mankind’s pioneering use of supply chains and a company-owned distribution setup bolsters
accessibility.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## With PAN-BIOTECH GmbH

## PAN-Biotech, is actively advancing its capabilities and product offerings in the following key
## areas:

## CELL AND GENE THERAPY:

## Development of specialized media and reagents to support the growth and production of cells and
## genes for therapeutic applications, enhancing the efficacy and safety of cutting-edge treatment

3

## the rapid and efficient development of vaccines, including those targeting emerging diseases.

3

## mRNA TECHNOLOGY:

## Innovation in mRNA technology, including the development of optimized media and delivery systems,
## to support the burgeoning field of mRNA-based therapeutics and vaccines.

3

## ANTIBODY PRODUCTION:

## Enhancement of products and processes for the production of high-quality antibodies, catering to
## research, diagnostics, and therapeutic applications.

3

##### mission is to empower our customers with the tools they need to make a meaningful impact on
##### the world.”

and shape the future of science and healthcare.

Jens Hartmann

President and CEO, PAN-Biotech GmbH

## committed to conducting business with honesty and accountability, building trust with clients,
## partners, and the scientific community.

3

## CUSTOMER FOCUS:

## PAN-Biotech is dedicated to understanding and meeting the specific needs of its clients. By
## offering personalized solutions and exceptional customer service, the company ensures that its
## products and services align with clients’ objectives and goals.

3

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

quality and safety at every stage of production.

manufacturing, and distribution.

international bodies. These include agencies such as *Health Canada*, *Therapeutic Goods

region-specific regulations are met and that pharmaceutical products meet global standards.

international bodies. These include agencies such as *Health Canada*, *Therapeutic Goods
Administration (TGA)* in Australia, and *European Medicines Agency (EMA)*, which impose requirements

region-specific regulations are met and that pharmaceutical products meet global standards.

regulatory compliance and operational excellence.

instructions that outline the specific steps required to perform routine tasks or processes in a
standardized and controlled manner. These procedures serve as the foundation for maintaining
consistent quality, ensuring regulatory compliance, and minimizing risks associated with drug

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

[BFS entdecken][42]
[bottelpack Anlagen entdecken][43]

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Preparation

1. Check equipment condition and cleanliness, and inspect pre-filled syringe packaging.
2. Prepare required filling material and solution.

Syringe Filling

1. Use automatic or semi-automatic syringe filling equipment.
2. Insert syringe, ensuring a tight connection, and fill accurately with desired material.

Inspection & Packing

1. Remove filled syringes from equipment and check capacity, seal integrity, and filling uniformity.
2. Package approved syringes, ensuring proper sealing performance.

Packing & Labeling

1.Place filled syringes in appropriate packaging materials.
2.Apply relevant labels and instructions on the packaging.

Syringe Filling

1. Use automatic or semi-automatic syringe filling equipment.

Inspection & Packing

1. Remove filled syringes from equipment and check capacity, seal integrity, and filling uniformity.
2. Package approved syringes, ensuring proper sealing performance.

Packing & Labeling

1.Place filled syringes in appropriate packaging materials.

## [**Taj Pharmaceuticals**][121], is a [generics pharmaceuticals company][122] with product range
## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

###  TAJ PHARMA MANUFACTURING

Our world class finished dosage manufacturing facility is located at At Village – Kalgam,Coastal
Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

Some of salient features of our facilities are
• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

assembler to warehouse — cost, time, and risk accumulate in ways that rarely show up on a line-item
quote. As OEMs face pressure to shorten lead times and simplify their supply chains, vendor
consolidation is emerging as one of the most practical levers available. This article breaks down

# Fix My Speakers 🔊

Eject 💦 water from your phone’s speakers after getting it wet.

Fix My Speakers – Water Eject 💦 from your phone’s speakers effortlessly💦

[💨 Let’s Start 💦][11]

Are you frustrated by your muffled speaker due to water or dust? Don’t worry Fix My Speaker easily
ejects the water and dust from the speaker. With just a few taps, you can restore your audio to its
former glory and enjoy the crystal-clear sound once again. So, what are you waiting for? Dive in,
play the speaker cleaner sounds, and get your speaker back in action.

[Fix My Speakers – Water Eject From Your Phone’s Speakers Effortlessly]

## Speaker Cleaner **Steps**
* Disconnect your mobile from a Bluetooth device or earbuds if you are using it.
* Turn up the volume to the maximum level.
* Hold your device tilted so the phone’s speaker is downwards.
* Select the sound, click play button and play the sound until the end.
* Play every sound three times until the end and then move to the next sound.

[💨 Let’s Start 💦][12]

Repeat this process if your speaker problem persists after playing every sound thrice.

### What is Fix My Speaker?

Fix My Speaker is an innovative web application that provides specialized cleaning sounds for mobile
speakers. By playing these sounds, you can efficiently expel water and clear away dust particles. It
offers a fast and effective solution to restore your speaker’s performance and sound clarity,
especially after water damage.

### How Does Fix My Speaker Work?

Fix My Speaker utilizes a variety of tones and sound waves, ranging from low to high frequencies, to
expel water and eliminate dust from your mobile speakers. It operates similarly to the water
ejection feature found in Apple Watches, providing an easy and effective way to restore your
speaker’s functionality.

### How does the Fix My Speakers process begin?

The process starts with a powerful sound burst at a high decibel level. This burst generates strong
vibrations that shake the speaker’s diaphragm, dislodging trapped water and initiating the cleaning
process.

### What ensures comprehensive cleaning?

After the initial burst, the system uses continuous frequency sweeps. These sweeps cycle through low
to high frequencies, effectively removing remaining water droplets and dust particles from the
speaker grill.

### How is residual moisture removed?

A high-pitched tone is used in the final step to eliminate any residual moisture. This tone reaches
deep into the speaker’s interior, drying out any remaining water for a completely clean and
moisture-free speaker.

[💨 Let’s Start 💦][13]


**Preventive Measures to Avoid Water Damage**
1. Avoid Water Exposure
   * Keep your phone away from liquids and steer clear of environments where it might come into
     contact with water, such as near pools, beaches, sinks, or during rain.
2. Use Protective Cases
   * Invest in a durable, water-resistant phone case. These cases provide an extra layer of
     protection against accidental spills, splashes, and humidity.
3. Be Cautious Outdoors
   * Environmental factors like rain, high humidity, and dust storms can damage electronic devices.
     When heading outdoors, especially during uncertain weather, protect your gadgets and
     accessories with waterproof covers.
4. Maintain Your Phone
   * Regular upkeep is crucial to prevent dust and moisture buildup. Clean your device regularly to
     ensure it remains dust-free and dry. [Learn more about keeping your phone clean here.]
5. Backup Your Data
   * Always save your important files on cloud services like Google Drive. This precaution ensures
     you don’t lose valuable data in case of severe damage or device failure.

[💨 For iPhone 💦][14]
[💨 Let’s Start 💦][15]

## **Immediate Actions to Take if Your Phone Gets Wet**
1. **Turn Off the Phone:** Power off your device immediately to avoid short circuits and prevent
   damage to electronic components caused by water.
2. **Disconnect Accessories:** Remove any accessories, such as cases, chargers, or headphones, to
   reduce the risk of further damage to the device.
3. **Dry the Exterior:** Gently dab the phone with a soft, lint-free cloth to absorb visible
   moisture. Avoid using heat sources like hairdryers, as they can damage internal components and
   the screen.
4. **Remove Moisture:** Carefully clean the exterior, focusing on areas like speaker grilles, using
   a soft cloth to eliminate trapped dust and moisture.
5. **Let It Dry:** Place the device in a dry, well-ventilated area for 24 to 48 hours to ensure all
   moisture evaporates before attempting to power it on again.
6. **Avoid Heat Exposure:** Do not use heat guns or direct heat to dry the phone, as this can cause
   additional damage to internal parts.

# WATER FOR INJECTION SYSTEMS

## proud to be AT the heart of the pharmaceutical manufacturing system

Water is an intrinsic component of all pharmaceutical formulations; without water there can be no
preparations to make vaccines, IV Fluids, parenteral solutions, ointments, eye drops, antibiotics,
creams and all drugs that require a solvent compatible with human nature. This BRAM-COR site
clarifies some aspects related to the use of Water for Injection and other pharmaceutical grade
waters, especially for the production of I.V. fluids and parenteral solutions. 

### Water for Injection definition

What is the meaning of "Water for Injection" in Europe rather than in Japan or US? Which one is
better between vapor compression or multiple effect distillation? Reverse osmosis systems can
produce cold WFI? There are differences between sterile and bacteriostatic wfi? What are the values
of reverse osmosis, ultrafiltration or UV treatment? When a water meets the pharmacopoeias
requirements of a pharmacopoeia is called a ***compendial* *water***. Although the correct water
treatment system is the basis for the final quality of any pharmaceutical solution, there are
factual differences in evaluation of the technologies used to produce each compendial water. All
these technologies are part of our core business, so these pages offer a concrete knowledge of the
leading considerations in pharmaceutical field. Our hope is that this site will be useful not only
to our customers, but also to the many students who ask us questions about the different grades of
water used in biotechnologies and in pharmaceutical applications. To discover all types of
pharmaceutical water in this website: [WFI and compendial waters in pharmacopoeias][15]


You can also read a "[Guideline on the quality of water for pharmaceutical use][16]" from EMA
(European Medicines Agency) (Site source: [https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/homepage][17])

[A classic Bram-Cor Multiple Effect Distiller working in a biopharma water treatment room]

### WFI Generators

Water For Injection can be produced through distillation or through a downstream unit of
ultrafiltration in a Reverse Osmosis system. Therefore, to produce Water for Injection (WFI) in a
absolutely safe way, usually you need a distiller; USP also allows RO systems, such as "a
purification process that is equivalent or superior to distillation in the removal of chemicals and
microorganisms" (like Reverse Osmosis coupled with electro-deionization, nanofiltration and,
downstream, **ultrafiltration**). To discover how to get WFI in this website: [Methods to produce
Water for Injection][18]


### Vaccine production forefront

[DEC 2019, Bram-Cor main factory, Parma (Italy). Set of seven STMC distiller in construction. They
will be delivered in the course of 2020]

Above: Bram-Cor main factory, Parma (Italy). Set of seven STMC distillers in construction. Today
they are at the forefront of vaccine production.

## BRAM-COR TECHNOLOGIES FOR WFI AND PW FORMULATIONS, INTRAVENOUS AND PARENTERAL SOLUTIONS

### Water for Injection equipment manufacturing

WFI equipment is made in compliance with International Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), which
are common to all BRAM-COR machines. It must also be remembered that all the different
Pharmacopoeias in the world are the basis form BRAM-COR's work. So we have an infinite number of
customizations. Visit our main web site ([bram-cor.com][19]) to discover BRAM-COR's expertise in
many types of pharmaceutical equipment, from water treatment to processing and filling.

We are also proud to say that our equipment is entirely manufactured and customized in Italy. In
fact, BRAM-COR experience and passion for working with stainless steel, allow usmto care for quality
in every details. In addition, energy saving, sanitary quality and certifications, long-term
reliability are the rule for BRAM-COR distillers and water treatment systems.

### How the Generators produces WFI
* Firstly, to discover how Vapor Compression Still (VCD) works: [Vapor Compression Distillation

* Similarly, to discover how Multi Effect Distiller (MED) works: [Multiple Effect Distillation

# WATER FOR INJECTION SYSTEMS

## proud to be AT the heart of the pharmaceutical manufacturing system

Water is an intrinsic component of all pharmaceutical formulations; without water there can be no
preparations to make vaccines, IV Fluids, parenteral solutions, ointments, eye drops, antibiotics,
creams and all drugs that require a solvent compatible with human nature. This BRAM-COR site
clarifies some aspects related to the use of Water for Injection and other pharmaceutical grade
waters, especially for the production of I.V. fluids and parenteral solutions. 

### Water for Injection definition

What is the meaning of "Water for Injection" in Europe rather than in Japan or US? Which one is
better between vapor compression or multiple effect distillation? Reverse osmosis systems can
produce cold WFI? There are differences between sterile and bacteriostatic wfi? What are the values
of reverse osmosis, ultrafiltration or UV treatment? When a water meets the pharmacopoeias
requirements of a pharmacopoeia is called a ***compendial* *water***. Although the correct water
treatment system is the basis for the final quality of any pharmaceutical solution, there are
factual differences in evaluation of the technologies used to produce each compendial water. All
these technologies are part of our core business, so these pages offer a concrete knowledge of the
leading considerations in pharmaceutical field. Our hope is that this site will be useful not only
to our customers, but also to the many students who ask us questions about the different grades of
water used in biotechnologies and in pharmaceutical applications. To discover all types of
pharmaceutical water in this website: [WFI and compendial waters in pharmacopoeias][15]


You can also read a "[Guideline on the quality of water for pharmaceutical use][16]" from EMA
(European Medicines Agency) (Site source: [https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/homepage][17])

[A classic Bram-Cor Multiple Effect Distiller working in a biopharma water treatment room]

### WFI Generators

Water For Injection can be produced through distillation or through a downstream unit of
ultrafiltration in a Reverse Osmosis system. Therefore, to produce Water for Injection (WFI) in a
absolutely safe way, usually you need a distiller; USP also allows RO systems, such as "a
purification process that is equivalent or superior to distillation in the removal of chemicals and
microorganisms" (like Reverse Osmosis coupled with electro-deionization, nanofiltration and,
downstream, **ultrafiltration**). To discover how to get WFI in this website: [Methods to produce
Water for Injection][18]

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
